title: Reddit's CEO Sure Seems Frustrated With Google's AI Overviews
excerpt: Amid rumors of Google breakup, Huffman says "people don't want a summary of reddit, they want reddit."
content_html:
Amid rumors of Google breakup, Huffman says "people don't want a summary of reddit, they want reddit."

Reddit

You can add Reddit CEO Steve Huffman to the growing list of publishers, platforms and others who are frustrated with the state of Google search and AI Overviews. "People don't want a summary of Reddit; they want Reddit," he wrote in a letter to shareholders ahead of the company's second-quarter earnings call.

In case there was any doubt that he was referring to Google's AI-powered search feature, Huffman was clear that Reddit has not benefited from the shift, despite its partnership with the search giant. The CEO said that AI Overviews haven't had "a similar level of positive impact" as traditional search.

"I think more broadly, what we see is, you know, 10 blue links has driven tremendous value and growth to the broader ecosystem," Huffman said, referring to traditional organic search results. "From where we sit, AI Overviews has yet to make a similar level of positive impact, and I think that's consistent across the broader landscape, right? Us businesses, publishers, retailers, we're still looking for that win-win."

Huffman's comments come as Reddit said that its traffic from search has taken a hit in recent months and after The Wall Street Journal reported that the company is rethinking its relationship with Google. Reddit hasn't publicly indicated whether it will renew or seek to change the terms of its existing arrangement with Google. When asked directly about the possibility of Reddit ending its $60 million licensing deal, Huffman left open the possibility. "I think the range of outcomes is wide, and we have to look at you know every aspect of this and make sure that we're maximizing value to Reddit," he said.

Reddit is far from the only platform to struggle with the changing search landscape. Publishers, some of whom have also reached deals with Google to license content, have also seen massive declines in search traffic as Google pushes AI-generated summaries that bury links and as more people replace traditional searches with chatbots. Google has claimed that AI-powered search features are broadly good for the industry.

Huffman said the company is working on other changes to help draw new users to the platform, including improvements to feed recommendations and other changes to make the site easier to understand for new users. He also said the company was considering "a video Reddit experience" and letting users "background listen" to posts.

"We see folks doing this off-platform," he said. "There's an emerging content type elsewhere on the internet of basically podcasts where people read Reddit content, and so I think this version of like listened-to or spoken-Reddit can be really engaging as well."

在谷歌解散的传言中，霍夫曼表示“人们想要的不是 Reddit 的摘要，而是 Reddit。”

红迪网

您可以将 Reddit 首席执行官 Steve Huffman 添加到不断增长的出版商、平台和其他对 Google 搜索和 AI 概述现状感到沮丧的人名单中。 “人们想要的不是 Reddit 的摘要；他们想要的是 Reddit，”他在公司第二季度财报电话会议之前致股东的信中写道。

如果有人怀疑他指的是谷歌的人工智能搜索功能，霍夫曼明确表示，尽管 Reddit 与这家搜索巨头合作，但它并没有从这一转变中受益。 这位首席执行官表示，人工智能概述尚未产生与传统搜索“类似水平的积极影响”。

“我认为更广泛地说，我们看到的是，你知道，10 个蓝色链接为更广泛的生态系统带来了巨大的价值和增长，”霍夫曼在谈到传统的有机搜索结果时说道。 “从我们的角度来看，人工智能概述尚未产生类似水平的积极影响，我认为这在更广泛的领域是一致的，对吗？ 美国企业、出版商、零售商，我们仍在寻求双赢。”

赫夫曼发表此番言论之际，Reddit 表示，近几个月来其搜索流量受到了打击，而且《华尔街日报》报道称该公司正在重新考虑与谷歌的关系。 Reddit 尚未公开表示是否会续签或寻求更改与谷歌现有协议的条款。 当直接被问及 Reddit 是否有可能终止其 6000 万美元的授权协议时，霍夫曼没有保留这种可能性。 “我认为结果的范围很广，我们必须考虑你是否了解这方面的各个方面，并确保我们最大限度地提高 Reddit 的价值，”他说。

Reddit 并不是唯一一个与不断变化的搜索环境作斗争的平台。 出版商（其中一些还与谷歌达成内容许可协议）也发现，随着谷歌推出人工智能生成的隐藏链接的摘要，以及越来越多的人用聊天机器人取代传统搜索，搜索流量大幅下降。 谷歌声称人工智能驱动的搜索功能对该行业总体有利。

霍夫曼表示，该公司正在努力进行其他改变，以帮助吸引新用户使用该平台，包括改进提要推荐和其他改变，以使新用户更容易理解该网站。 他还表示，该公司正在考虑“提供视频 Reddit 体验”，并让用户“后台收听”帖子。

“我们看到人们在平台外这样做，”他说。 “互联网上其他地方有一种新兴的内容类型，基本上是播客，人们可以在其中阅读 Reddit 内容，所以我认为这个版本的听或说 Reddit 也可以真正吸引人。”
